quantityHelp: Use a positive quantity with up to three decimal places.
cannotAdd: This product cannot be added right now.
invalidQuantity: Enter a quantity greater than zero with no more than three decimal places.
added: Added to your cart. Stock and price will be checked in the cart.
unchecked: Stock and price have not been checked yet.
unavailable: This product is no longer available. Remove it to continue.
insufficient-stock: There is not enough stock for this quantity.
error: Could not verify this product. Refresh items when online.
priceChanged: The price or currency has changed. Review the current unit price before continuing.
title: Your cart
priceNote: Final prices and availability are confirmed by the server at checkout.
storageUnavailable: Your cart can be used here, but changes may not survive a reload because browser storage is unavailable.
offline: You are offline. Saved details may be out of date. You can edit your cart; reconnect to check items and continue to checkout.
checkoutBlocked: Resolve item warnings or refresh items before checkout. An internet connection is required.
saveChanges: Save your quantity changes before continuing to checkout.
